summary: Bonner County, ID tower site: camp 1915, cupola cabin 1925, 76-ft steel tower 1934, last used 1941; top half dropped 1974, lower 20 ft reused 1977. Gone.

facts.design: D-6 style cupola cabin (1925); 76-foot Aermotor steel tower with 7-by-7 cab (1934)
facts.status_note: Tower removed in 1974 and 1977; no source describes what remains on the summit today

access.note: One trip account describes hiking, motorcycle and ATV trails to the summit; no closure found in the sources read

visit.trail_note: Reached by forest roads and trails; the route one account describes is rocky and rutty in places

notes_for_editor: History is consistent across sources. Nothing describes the site today; the story says so. The record's height of 23.2 m matches the 76-ft 1934 tower, not the 1925 cabin. Public access is inferred from one trip account describing summit trails, so the access level is medium confidence. The record's 1974 abandoned event is corrected to 1941 last use plus the 1974 failed move.
